sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 760. Success value 100. 10x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Slumber for 40 seconds with a success value of 180.
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 50. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 150 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
-Target: yourself. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies 50% elevation for 150 seconds.
